value.title: List of James Bond vehicles
value.extract: Throughout the James Bond series of films and novels, Q Branch has given Bond a variety of vehicles with which to battle his enemies. Among the most noteworthy gadgets, Bond has been equipped with various vehicles that have numerous modifications to include elaborate weapons and anti-pursuit systems, alternative transportation modes, and various other functions. One car in particular that has been linked to Mr. Bond's collection is the Aston Martin DB5. This is a list of noteworthy vehicles seen in James Bond, used by either Bond himself, his allies, or his enemies.
